svg.aria-label: Breadboard drawing: an Arduino Nano 33 IoT across the middle of a breadboard, and to its right three separate rows. In the 3.3V row: a red wire from the 3.3V pin and one lead of the Velostat sensor. In the A0 row: a yellow wire from A0, the other sensor lead and one leg of a 10 kilohm resistor. In the GND row: the resistor's other leg and a black wire from GND.
svg.text: 3.3V row (26): red wire from the 3.3V pin + one sensor lead
A0 row (23): yellow wire from A0 + the other sensor lead + the 10kΩ resistor
GND row (20): the 10kΩ resistor's other leg + black wire from GND
Use 3.3V, never 5V or VUSB: the Nano 33 IoT's pins only take 3.3V.
